_comment: SCALE-UP of data_g2_research.json to 11-16 physical qubits. Same families, same runtimes, same candidate bank size and the same teacher.mode=none, so headroom measured here is directly comparable to the 3-10 qubit campaign at the same search budget. Only the logical sizes and chain lengths move, which is the point: aggregate_frontier stratifies by physical_size, so the two campaigns together give a size trend from 3 to 16 rather than two unrelated numbers. No spectral teacher is possible at these sizes -- the full teacher is capped at 10 physical qubits -- so the privileged-oracle comparison does NOT extend here and must not be quoted above 10.
